name: research-kernel
description: Provider-neutral Research OS for Claude Code: twelve canonical research roles (math-reviewer, dl-engineer, research-mentor, results-analyst, paper-writer, study-coach, science-presenter, memory-curator + isolated blind-reviewer, experiment-runner, regression-guardian, repo-maintainer), a methodological constitution with a canary handshake, per-project state templates, and a task-shape effort policy. Project facts live in your project's .claude/research-kernel.overlay.md, never in the plugin.
